Electron 33 e2e with stubbed native dialog: picker imports 3 sample docs, rejects .pdf with message, sidebar + status bar update, cancel is a no-op. Drag-and-drop path (webUtils.getPathForFile) not exercised by a real OS drag.

features.name: Document Detail with Content
features.description: DocumentDetail shows full document content, metadata, and delete button
features.evidence: npm run check clean; vitest 19/19 incl. src/services/document-detail.test.ts (full content returned, unknown/path-like IDs return null, delete removes meta + stored original + content + chunks + index entry, unknown-ID delete no-op). Electron 33 e2e (temp userData, stubbed picker): imported 3 samples, detail shows metadata + word count, rendered content equals source file byte-for-byte, switching docs loads the new content, Delete shows inline confirm, Cancel keeps doc, Confirm removes it from sidebar (3->2) and leaves no files on disk. Not covered: 10 MB render performance.
